==English==

===Etymology===
From [[Wikipedia:English language|English]] {{suf|en|opine|ion}}, from {{der|en|enm|opinion}}, {{m|enm|opinioun}}, from {{der|en|xno|-}} and {{der|en|frm|opinion}}<!--note, have to specify a language here to avoid a self-link-->, from {{der|en|la|opīniō}}, from {{m|la|opīnor||to opine}}. Displaced native {{ncog|ang|wēna}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/əˈpɪn.jən/}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-opinion.ogg|a=California}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Naomi Persephone Amethyst (NaomiAmethyst)-opinion.wav|a=North Carolina}}
* {{hyphenation|en|opin|ion}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪnjən|s=3}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# A belief, judgment or perspective that a [[person]] has formed, either through [[objective]] or [[subjective]] reasoning, about a [[topic]], [[issue]], person or thing.
#: {{syn|en|conclusion|piece|sentiment|sight|take|verdict|view|Thesaurus:judgement}}
#: {{ux|en|I would like to know your '''opinions''' on the new filing system.}}
#: {{ux|en|In my '''opinion''', white chocolate is better than milk chocolate.}}
#: {{ux|en|Every man is a fool in some man's '''opinion'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|We invite you to state your '''opinions''' about the suggestions.}}
# The judgment or sentiment which the mind forms of persons or things; [[estimation]].
#: {{syn|en|assessment|esteem|regard}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Macbeth|I|vii|135|1|line=32|text=I haue bought / Golden '''Opinions''' from all ſorts of people, {{...}}}}
#* {{RQ:South Twelve Sermons|text=Friendship {{...}} gives a man a peculiar right and claim to the good '''opinion''' of his friend.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} Favorable estimation; hence, [[consideration]]; [[reputation]]; [[fame]]; [[public]] [[sentiment]] or [[esteem]].
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Henry 4-1 Q1|V|iv|page=82|signature=K2|verso=1|text=Thou haſt redeemed thy loſt '''opinion''', {{...}}}}
#* {{RQ:Milton History|page=70|passage=This gain’d ''Agricola'' much '''opinion'''; who {{...}} had made ſuch early progreſs into laborious {{...}} enterpriſes.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} Obstinacy in holding to one's belief or impression; [[opiniativeness]]; [[conceitedness]].
#: {{syn|en|dogmatism}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Love's Labour's Lost Q1|V|i|page=45|lines=3–6|text={{...}} your reaſons at Dinner haue been ſharpe & ſententious: pleaſant without ſcurillitie, wittie without affection, audatious without impudencie, learned without '''opinion''', and ſtrange without hereſie: {{...}}}}
# The formal decision, or expression of views, of a judge, an umpire, a doctor, or other party officially called upon to consider and decide upon a matter or point submitted.
#: {{syn|en|decision|judgment|order|ruling}}
# {{lb|en|European Union|_|law}} A [[judicial]] opinion delivered by an Advocate General to the European Court of Justice where he or she proposes a legal solution to the cases for which the court is responsible.

# {{lb|en|transitive|archaic}} To have or express as an opinion.
#* {{RQ:Browne Religio Medici|edition=4th|page=97|passage=Philoſophers that '''opinioned''' the vvorlds deſtruction by fire, did never dreame of annihilation, vvhich is beyond the povver of ſublunary cauſes; for the laſt and proper action of that element {{quote-gloss|fire}} is but vitrification, or a reduction of a body into Glaſſe, and therefore ſome of our Chymicks factiouſly affirme; yea, and urge Scripture for it, that at the laſt fire all ſhall be cryſtallized and reverberated into Glaſſe, vvhich is the utmoſt action of that element.}}
#* {{RQ:Browne Hydriotaphia|page=|passage=But if (as some '''opinion''') King ''Ahasuerus'' were ''Artaxerxes Mnemon''{{nb...}}, our magnified ''Cyrus'' was his second Brother {{...}}}}
